The publishing function is `emit()` in `src/lib/event-bus.ts`. It is the only function that dispatches to subscribers. `emitAndForget()` is a wrapper around it, but no source file calls it.

I searched every `src/` file for calls to `emit`. Twelve source files call it directly, each importing it from `@/lib/event-bus`:

- `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts` (`webhook.delivery_requested`)
- `src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts` (`issue.overdue`)
- `src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts` (`billing.plan_changed`)
- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` (`billing.limit_exceeded`, two calls)
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` (`billing.limit_exceeded`, `billing.plan_changed`)
- `src/server/services/member-service.ts` (`member.role_changed`, `member.removed`)
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` (six calls: created, updated, status_changed, assigned, archived)
- `src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts` (`flag.toggled`)
- `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts` (`member.invited`, `member.joined`)
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts` (`comment.created`, `comment.deleted`)
- `src/server/services/project-service.ts` (created, archived, restored)
- `src/server/services/organization-service.ts` (`member.joined`)

Left out:

- **Subscribe-only files:** `event-registry.ts`, `activity-service.ts`, `webhook-service.ts`, `search-service.ts`, `notification-service.ts`, and `usage-service.ts`'s `subscribe` call. These register handlers.
- **`src/server/services/auth-service.ts`:** it imports no `emit` and does not call it. Its header says registration publishes `member.joined` indirectly, through `createOrganization` in `organization-service.ts`.
- **`src/components/domain/comment/mention-textarea.tsx`:** its `emit` is a local component function, not the bus.
- **Test files** call `emit` too (`tests/lib/event-bus.test.ts`, `tests/services/activity-service.test.ts`, `tests/services/notification-service.test.ts`). I left them out because they are not source files.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts, src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts
